title: Duterte impeachment trial: Bank, AMLC documents admitted as prosecution evidence
summary: The Senate impeachment court has admitted as evidence several documents formally offered by the prosecution as it rejected the “fishing expedition” claim of Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp.
